results.name: 1. Gemini connectivity
results.test: Read key from Windows Credential Manager; make a minimal live call
results.expected: A non-empty text response from Gemini (e.g. 'OK')
results.actual: No Gemini API key found in the OS credential store; a live call cannot be made without one.
results.fix: Run 'python -m void set-key gemini' (the key is entered hidden and never printed), then re-run this check.

results.name: 2. Local Ollama connectivity
results.test: HTTP GET /api/tags on the local Ollama server
results.expected: HTTP 200 with a JSON list of locally installed models
results.error: <urlopen error [WinError 10061] No connection could be made because the target machine actively refused it>
results.fix: Ollama is the OPTIONAL offline fallback (Gemini is primary). To enable: install Ollama (free, local), run 'ollama serve', then 'ollama pull llama3.1:8b'.

results.name: 3. Windows app launching / os.startfile
results.test: Open a fresh temp .txt via os.startfile and launch Calculator, both through void's real AppActions code
results.expected: Both return ok=True (a text viewer and Calculator open); no personal files touched

results.name: 4. PySide6 circular widget
results.test: Construct QApplication + VoidWidget and render it to a PNG
results.expected: Widget class constructs and renders; a PNG image is produced
results.actual: Constructed OK; PNG saved=True; file=widget_render.png; bytes=9030; pixmap=510x450
